- Atelectasis is identified as lingular scarring or volume loss in the lung.
- Lung lesions are present in the form of innumerable bilateral calcified nodules.
- Cardiomegaly and pleural effusion are explicitly noted as absent across multiple examinations.
- No fractures or acute skeletal abnormalities were reported in the reviewed findings.
